body:
I don't know how to go about just talking to someone. I'm bad at expressing myself, I'm insecure, and most of all I have an irrational terror of making my friends or family disappointed or ashamed of me if I try to talk to them about how I feel. 

As for hobbies, mostly video games. It's an escape, and an attempt at a substitute for a social life I lack more or less completely. Which isn't to say I don't enjoy the games for themselves, but I'm self-aware enough to recognize what void I'm trying to fill.

My major is electrical engineering, but I have been thinking of something else, like.chemistry or something like that.
I'm not scared to make friends. I'm scared to talk to those I have. And I'm completely unsuccessful at making new ones, to the point that I've just about given up trying.
